source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, filter WATCHDOG2, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 69.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool with the exact name, but truncates OOB fallback and omits full IB/Web/discrete-state and reset context.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires record/function/state decoding and prohibits arming, petting, expiration, reset, clearing or configuration.

old_problem: WATCHDOG2 may be a discrete timer/event record rather than an analog sensor, so a successful `sensor get` does not define raw-bit meaning, timer function, armed/expired/reset semantics or acceptable state. The source also orders log clearing that could destroy watchdog-reset evidence and jumps from criteria 2 to 69.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by parameterizing the exact SDR record ID/type, watchdog function and raw-to-decoded state map under ED-03 while retaining complete IB/OOB/Web evidence. ED-17 requires preserving SEL/reset evidence, ED-18 separates any reset/cycle behavior from this passive row, and ED-15 prevents invented acceptable states. No watchdog stimulus or timer state change is part of the test.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2031, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2032 / Wistron-BMC-00484-V003 / ce41ec26bca184f9.
WATCHDOG2 is bound by record ID/type and function; raw discrete bytes/bits and decoded labels are compared under the approved versioned mapping rather than treated as ranged analog data by default.
Complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus the Web row are retained. `sensor get` is supplemental only when the record type/tool supports it, never a substitute for source surfaces.
Existing watchdog, reset, host, BMC and SEL context is captured before reads and never cleared; active/expired/reset states cause a stop and evidence preservation, not automatic retry.
Criteria 1, 2 and 69 remain explicit; missing 3-68 are not fabricated.
No ipmitool, watchdog read, authentication, Web capture, timer arm/pet/expire/reset/configure/clear, log clear, host/BMC reset or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Record-type-aware WATCHDOG2 passive state and reset-evidence reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact WATCHDOG2 record identity and raw/decoded passive state across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web against the approved watchdog-function model while preserving all reset and SEL evidence and never altering timer state.
required_package: SUT/BMC/firmware/channel identities and exact WATCHDOG2 SDR record ID/type/function map
Versioned raw byte/bit to decoded state mapping, expected inactive/armed/expired/reset semantics, units/thresholds only if applicable, and freshness rules
IB/OOB/Web field crosswalk and approved equivalent view if `sensor get` is unsupported for the record type
Pre-existing watchdog/host/BMC reset and SEL context, approved ipmitool and protected access
BMC/platform owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; first preserve watchdog, reset and SEL context without clearing anything. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs and exact-match WATCHDOG2 by record ID/name; use `sensor get WATCHDOG2` only if the approved record/tool mapping supports it. Capture the complete Web row and compare raw and decoded fields with the versioned state map. Do not arm, pet, expire, reset, clear, configure or inject a watchdog, clear logs, restart host/BMC or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The same WATCHDOG2 record is present in every supported view with aligned raw and decoded state, correct description/function and freshness under the approved model, with preserved reset/SEL context and no unexpected active, expired or reset condition.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact record/type/function identity, complete supported-view evidence and raw/decoded fields matching the approved state map. FAIL on missing/duplicate/stale record, raw/decoded mismatch, unexplained active/expired/reset state, channel discrepancy or lost reset evidence. Missing record/state mapping is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Read-only observation only; no watchdog arm, pet, expiration, reset, configuration, clear or fault injection.
Preserve SEL, host/BMC reset and watchdog evidence before all reads; protect credentials.
Stop immediately on active/expired/reset state, unknown record type, channel mismatch or access anomaly.
No automatic retry, host/BMC restart or log clearing; preserve first raw bytes, timestamps and context.
expected_evidence: WATCHDOG2 SDR record ID/type/function and raw-bit decode specification
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Supported sensor-get output and complete Web row with raw/decoded mapping
Preserved watchdog/host/BMC reset and SEL context plus channel/freshness comparison
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, access failure, unknown record type, active/expired/reset state or channel mismatch, stop all collection and preserve the first state plus SEL/reset evidence. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not pet/reset/reconfigure the watchdog, clear logs, restart systems or retry; escalate with record ID/raw bytes/timestamps.

source_conflict.reason: A versioned record-type/function/raw-state map resolves WATCHDOG2 semantics; preserving instead of clearing reset/SEL evidence corrects the safety conflict without adding stimulus.

blocked.reason: The passive operation, state-decoding boundary, evidence, safety and recovery are complete; record mapping and expected state are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: WATCHDOG2 record ID/type/function, raw-to-decoded expected-state map, view crosswalk/freshness and existing reset/SEL context.
